title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pallavan posts Pandian with a girl, sparking Vannathi's wrath. Cheran explains his past, while the brothers fake a fast to dodge Chandayatha's cooking and her demands.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar warns Suresh and Thangaraj, then defends her family to Bagyaraj as Shruthi apologises. Later, she resumes chores with Mathi and calls Karthi about her mother.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi is shocked to learn that Vellathai and others are gradually losing their vision. Rajangam thanks Karuppu for saving him and Sethupathi from the angry villagers.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan is impressed by Pooja's orthodox nature at the temple. Shyam presses Madhu for answers, leading her to reveal that Arjun tied a Thaali around her neck.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani is startled by Chokka Thangam's fake ghost outside the window and hugs Anbu in fear. Later, she bursts out laughing when Anbu is startled by the midnight phone call.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Angered by Shanmugam's love issues, Kandhasamy forbids him from going to college. Later, Shanmugam's brothers console him as he struggles after his breakup with Abhi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Deeply hurt by Saravanan's words, Thangamayil leaves home after writing a letter. Worried by her disappearance, Gomathi and Pandian urge Saravanan to bring her back.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini's request moves Parvathy to let her start a parlour at home. At the inauguration, Muthu responds to Vasudevan's mockery in fluent English, making Vijaya proud.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Shanmugam slaps Abinaya for leaving without informing anyone and convinces her to return home. Prabhakaran suggests a court notice to help Vetri live with Sudar and Abinaya.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: A playful turmeric-water prank ends with Azhagar pulling Poongodi into the pool. Touched by her emotional plea, Manjamalai forgives Poongodi before she heads to Azhagar's home.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Tricked by Ilamathi, Paraman and Viji take a secret DNA test after finding Ayyapan alive. Meanwhile, Rishi finds a police report with a photo of her dead son.
